description: Automobiles Annual Imports and Exports Through Port Authority of NY NJ Maritime Terminals: Beginning 2000 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. This dataset represents the total number of Automobiles Imported and Exported annually through maritime terminals located within Port Authority property in the Port of New York and New Jersey in vehicle units beginning 2000. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are maritime, povs, port authority, port, automobiles. The table has 3 columns. Attribution on the portal: The Port Authority of New York & New Jersey. The portal shows 2016-03-25 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
